name: Perfection

features.text: Formulated for da random- orbital polishers
Fast scratch & oxidation removal without swirls

description: A versatile finishing wax that cleans, polishes and protects, leaving a durable high-gloss finish on painted surfaces. MP Pro Series™ Perfection™ Finish Wax is specially formulated for use with DA Random-Orbital Polishers to remove light scratches, oxidation and swirl marks without dust or residue to clean up. Designed for use with MP Pro Series™ microfiber or foam finishing pads.
application: Directions: For best results, use our BLACKSPEED long-throw polisher (#70339) and microfiber cutting (#70337) Please note : vehicle should be clean, cool, and out of direct sunlight. If necessary, clay vehicle surface prior to correcting paint. DA Polisher: 1) Apply 4 to 5 dime-sized drops of product directly to Finishing Pad. 2) Set DA Polisher at medium to high speed (4000–6000 OPM) 3) Using mild pressure, buff a 2’x2’ section of the painted surface side to side and then up and down in overlapping passes. 4) Repeat Steps 1 and 3 until the surface has a high-gloss finish. 5) Wipe off any remaining residue using a clean microfiber towel. Hand Use: 1) Apply product to a clean, soft cloth or sponge. 2) Using an overlapping circular motion, wipe product onto painted surface. 3) Allow product to haze and buff off with a clean microfiber towel until the surface has a glossy finish.
